snippet.description:
[Review Number 479] I play some Omega Crafter and give my opinion throughout... How does the game compare to similar open world crafting automation games like ASKA, Bellwright, Medieval Dynasty or Palworld? Is it worth buying or playing for $25?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:00 Verdict

Steam description: "Adventure in a vast open-world survival craft game with your programmable sidekick Grammi! Program the Grammi to collect materials, build your town, craft weapons and armor to challenge strong enemies! Play alone or with friends online!"
